Geometry mobjects

Source: R/geometry.R, R/zz_constructors.R
geometry.Rd

Constructors for basic shapes. Each Foo() function creates an object of the R6 class FooClass, whose generator is exported for subclassing. Arguments mirror Manim; unlisted arguments in ... are passed on to VMobject() (for example color, fill_opacity, stroke_width).

Usage

Arc(
  radius = 1,
  start_angle = 0,
  angle = TAU/4,
  num_components = 9,
  arc_center = ORIGIN,
  ...
)

ArcBetweenPoints(start, end, angle = TAU/4, radius = NULL, ...)

CurvedArrow(start_point, end_point, tip_shape = NULL, ...)

CurvedDoubleArrow(
  start_point,
  end_point,
  tip_shape_start = NULL,
  tip_shape_end = NULL,
  ...
)

Circle(radius = NULL, color = "#FC6255", ...)

circle_from_three_points(p1, p2, p3, ...)

Dot(
  point = ORIGIN,
  radius = DEFAULT_DOT_RADIUS,
  stroke_width = 0,
  fill_opacity = 1,
  color = "#FFFFFF",
  ...
)

AnnotationDot(
  radius = DEFAULT_DOT_RADIUS * 1.3,
  stroke_width = 5,
  stroke_color = "#FFFFFF",
  fill_color = BLUE,
  ...
)

LabeledDot(label, radius = NULL, buff = SMALL_BUFF, ...)

Ellipse(width = 2, height = 1, ...)

AnnularSector(
  inner_radius = 1,
  outer_radius = 2,
  angle = TAU/4,
  start_angle = 0,
  fill_opacity = 1,
  stroke_width = 0,
  color = "#FFFFFF",
  ...
)

Sector(radius = 1, ...)

Annulus(
  inner_radius = 1,
  outer_radius = 2,
  fill_opacity = 1,
  stroke_width = 0,
  color = "#FFFFFF",
  ...
)

CubicBezier(start_anchor, start_handle, end_handle, end_anchor, ...)

ArcPolygon(..., angle = PI/4, radius = NULL, arc_config = NULL)

ArcPolygonFromArcs(...)

Line(start = LEFT, end = RIGHT, buff = 0, path_arc = 0, ...)

DashedLine(..., dash_length = DEFAULT_DASH_LENGTH, dashed_ratio = 0.5)

TangentLine(vmob, alpha, length = 1, d_alpha = 1e-06, ...)

Elbow(width = 0.2, angle = 0, ...)

Arrow(
  ...,
  stroke_width = 6,
  buff = MED_SMALL_BUFF,
  max_tip_length_to_length_ratio = 0.25,
  max_stroke_width_to_length_ratio = 5,
  tip_shape = NULL
)

Vector(direction = RIGHT, buff = 0, ...)

DoubleArrow(..., tip_shape_start = NULL, tip_shape_end = NULL)

Angle(
  line1,
  line2,
  radius = NULL,
  quadrant = c(1, 1),
  other_angle = FALSE,
  dot = FALSE,
  dot_radius = NULL,
  dot_distance = 0.55,
  dot_color = "#FFFFFF",
  elbow = FALSE,
  ...
)

angle_from_three_points(A, B, C, ...)

RightAngle(line1, line2, length = NULL, ...)

Polygram(..., color = BLUE)

Polygon(...)

RegularPolygram(num_vertices, density = 2, radius = 1, start_angle = NULL, ...)

RegularPolygon(n = 6, ...)

Triangle(...)

Star(
  n = 5,
  outer_radius = 1,
  inner_radius = NULL,
  density = 2,
  start_angle = TAU/4,
  ...
)

Rectangle(
  color = "#FFFFFF",
  height = 2,
  width = 4,
  grid_xstep = NULL,
  grid_ystep = NULL,
  mark_paths_closed = TRUE,
  close_new_points = TRUE,
  ...
)

Square(side_length = 2, ...)

RoundedRectangle(corner_radius = 0.5, ...)

Cutout(main_shape, ...)

ConvexHull(..., tolerance = 1e-05)

SurroundingRectangle(
  ...,
  color = PURE_YELLOW,
  buff = SMALL_BUFF,
  corner_radius = 0
)

BackgroundRectangle(
  ...,
  color = NULL,
  stroke_width = 0,
  stroke_opacity = 0,
  fill_opacity = 0.75,
  buff = 0
)

Cross(
  mobject = NULL,
  stroke_color = "#FC6255",
  stroke_width = 6,
  scale_factor = 1,
  ...
)

Underline(mobject, buff = SMALL_BUFF, ...)

TangentialArc(line1, line2, radius, corner = c(1, 1), ...)

TipableVMobject(
  tip_length = DEFAULT_ARROW_TIP_LENGTH,
  normal_vector = OUT,
  tip_style = NULL,
  ...
)

ArrowTip(...)

ArrowTriangleTip(
  fill_opacity = 0,
  stroke_width = 3,
  length = DEFAULT_ARROW_TIP_LENGTH,
  width = DEFAULT_ARROW_TIP_LENGTH,
  start_angle = PI,
  ...
)

ArrowTriangleFilledTip(fill_opacity = 1, stroke_width = 0, ...)

ArrowCircleTip(
  fill_opacity = 0,
  stroke_width = 3,
  length = DEFAULT_ARROW_TIP_LENGTH,
  start_angle = PI,
  ...
)

ArrowCircleFilledTip(fill_opacity = 1, stroke_width = 0, ...)

ArrowSquareTip(
  fill_opacity = 0,
  stroke_width = 3,
  length = DEFAULT_ARROW_TIP_LENGTH,
  start_angle = PI,
  ...
)

ArrowSquareFilledTip(fill_opacity = 1, stroke_width = 0, ...)

StealthTip(
  fill_opacity = 1,
  stroke_width = 3,
  length = DEFAULT_ARROW_TIP_LENGTH/2,
  start_angle = PI,
  ...
)

Arguments

radius

Radius.

start_angle

Starting angle.

angle

Angle.

num_components

Number of anchor points used to approximate an arc.

arc_center

Center of the arc.

...

Arguments passed to the class initializer.

start, end

Start and end points of a line or arc.

start_point, end_point

Endpoints.

tip_shape, tip_shape_start, tip_shape_end

Tip classes such as ArrowTriangleTipClass.

color, fill_color, fill_opacity, stroke_opacity

Color, fill color, fill opacity and stroke opacity of the shape.

p1, p2, p3

Points on the circle.

point

Location of the dot's center.

stroke_color, stroke_width

Stroke style.

label

A string (rendered with MathTex()) or a mobject.

buff

Buffer.

width

Width.

height

Height of the shape.

outer_radius, inner_radius

Radii.

start_anchor, start_handle, end_handle, end_anchor

Bezier control points.

arc_config

List of argument lists, one per arc.

path_arc

Angle of the arc a line bends along; 0 gives a straight line.

dash_length, dashed_ratio

Length of each dash, and the fraction of the line covered by dashes rather than gaps.

vmob

A VMobject.

alpha

Proportion along vmob.

length

Length.

d_alpha

Step used to estimate the tangent.

max_tip_length_to_length_ratio, max_stroke_width_to_length_ratio

Upper bounds on the tip length and the stroke width relative to the arrow length, so short arrows stay well proportioned.

direction

Direction of the vector.

line1, line2

Lines.

quadrant

Pair of 1 or -1 choosing, for each line, whether the angle is measured toward its end (1) or its start (-1).

other_angle

Draw the reflex angle, going clockwise, instead.

dot, dot_radius, dot_distance, dot_color

Whether to mark the angle with a dot, the dot's radius, its distance from the vertex as a fraction of the radius, and its color.

elbow

Draw a right angle elbow instead of an arc.

A, B, C

Points; the angle is at B.

num_vertices

Number of vertices of the regular polygram.

density

Density of the star.

n

Number of points.

grid_xstep, grid_ystep

Spacing of optional grid lines drawn inside the rectangle; NULL draws none.

mark_paths_closed, close_new_points

Treat the outline as a closed path.

side_length

Side length of the square.

corner_radius

Radius of the rounded corners.

main_shape

Shape to cut holes into.

tolerance

Tolerance for nearly collinear points; accepted for compatibility with Manim.

mobject

A mobject.

scale_factor

Scale factor.

corner

Which corner between the lines, as c(1, 1) and so on.

tip_length

Length of tips added with add_tip().

normal_vector

Normal of the plane tips are drawn in.

tip_style

List of style arguments for added tips.

Value

A mobject.

Examples

Circle(radius = 2, color = BLUE)
#> <Circle> 32 points, 0 submobjects
Square(side_length = 1)$shift(LEFT)
Arrow(LEFT, RIGHT)
#> <Arrow> 4 points, 1 submobjects
Polygon(c(-1, 0, 0), c(1, 0, 0), c(0, 1, 0))
#> <Polygon> 12 points, 0 submobjects
